_meta.note: Companion notes for STS_CARDS_DB_CLAUDE.json. Documents all anomalies (data bugs, missing fields, dynamic effects) and field completions found during the review of cards from 'Infernal Blade' to 'Zap'. Keyed by card ID.

Iron Wave.detail: Original entry was missing scalesWithDexterity:true. Iron Wave grants Block that scales with Dexterity in STS, consistent with all other block cards that bear that flag.

Limit Break.detail: Original had selfExhaustOnPlay: { base: true, upgraded: true }, but Limit Break+'s descriptionUpgraded reads 'Double your Strength.' with no Exhaust clause. Limit Break+ is intentionally non-exhausting.
Limit Break.fix: Corrected to selfExhaustOnPlay: { base: true, upgraded: false }.

Rainbow.summary: Missing Frost and Dark orb interactions
Rainbow.detail: Original entry only had a single Lightning orbInteraction. Rainbow channels 1 Lightning + 1 Frost + 1 Dark. The Frost and Dark entries were absent.
Rainbow.fix: Added FROST_ORB and DARK_ORB channel entries, each with amount: { base: 1 }.

Secret Technique.detail: Original had selfExhaustOnPlay: { base: true, upgraded: true }, but the descriptionUpgraded reads 'Put a Skill from your draw pile into your hand.' — no Exhaust. Secret Technique+ removes the Exhaust.
Secret Technique.fix: Corrected to selfExhaustOnPlay: { base: true, upgraded: false }.

Secret Weapon.detail: Original had selfExhaustOnPlay: { base: true, upgraded: true }, but the descriptionUpgraded reads 'Put an Attack from your draw pile into your hand.' — no Exhaust. Secret Weapon+ removes the Exhaust.
Secret Weapon.fix: Corrected to selfExhaustOnPlay: { base: true, upgraded: false }.

Thinking Ahead.detail: Original had selfExhaustOnPlay: { base: true, upgraded: true }, but the descriptionUpgraded reads 'Draw 2 cards. Put a card from your hand on top of your draw pile.' — no Exhaust.
Thinking Ahead.fix: Corrected to selfExhaustOnPlay: { base: true, upgraded: false }.

Terror.detail: Both appliesDebuffs.vulnerable and top-level vulnerable are set to { base: 99 }. This is a sentinel value representing 'Permanently Vulnerable' — a state that cannot be cleansed by normal means. Not a real stack count.

Malaise.summary: X-cost debuff scaling represented with xNumber:true flag
Malaise.detail: Malaise applies X Strength loss and X Weak (X+1 when upgraded). The debuff amount is proportional to energy spent. Represented using the new xNumber:true flag on appliesDebuffs entries, which causes galleryStsGlyphs to render 'X' instead of a numeric value.
Malaise.fix: Added appliesDebuffs: { weak: { xNumber: true }, losestrength: { xNumber: true } }.

Stack.summary: Block equals discard pile count — represented with hideNumber:true
Stack.detail: Stack gains Block equal to the number of cards in the discard pile (+3 when upgraded). The block amount is purely dynamic at runtime. Represented as block: { base: 0, hideNumber: true } so the block icon appears in glyphs without a misleading number.

Wallop.summary: Block equals unblocked damage dealt — represented with hideNumber:true
Wallop.detail: Wallop gains Block equal to the amount of unblocked damage it deals. The value is determined at combat resolution time. Represented as block: { base: 0, hideNumber: true }. Does not scale with Dexterity (block mirrors damage, which scales with Strength only).
Wallop.fix: Added block: { base: 0, hideNumber: true }. No scalesWithDexterity.

Unload.summary: Discards all non-Attack cards — represented with hideNumber:true
Unload.detail: Unload discards all non-Attack cards currently in hand. The count depends on runtime hand composition. Represented as discardEffect: { base: 0, hideNumber: true } so the discard icon appears in glyphs without a misleading number.

Scrape.summary: Discards drawn non-zero-cost cards — represented with hideNumber+conditioned
Scrape.detail: Scrape draws 4 (5) cards then discards every drawn card that doesn't cost 0. The discard count is wholly dependent on card costs at draw time. Represented as discardEffect with hideNumber:true and conditioned:true to flag the conditional nature.
Scrape.fix: Added discardEffect: { base: 0, hideNumber: true, conditioned: true, trigger: "cards that don't cost 0" }.

Wish.summary: Three mutually exclusive options grouped in wish_buffs sub-object
Wish.detail: Wish is a choose-one card: the player picks exactly one of (Plated Armor 6/8), (Strength 3/4), or (Gold 25/30). Options are now stored in a wish_buffs sub-object instead of separate top-level fields. galleryStsGlyphs renders a single cluster with all three options separated by OR. cards_meant lists the three choice cards.
Wish.fix: Restructured to wish_buffs: { plated_armor, strength_gain, gain_gold }. Added cards_meant: ["Live Forever", "Become Almighty", "Fame and Fortune"]. Added wish-buffs glyph cluster in galleryStsGlyphs.ts.

Strike_B.detail: Strike_B, Strike_G, Strike_P, and Strike_R all use the field name 'character' (singular) rather than 'characters' (plural) used by every other card. This appears to be intentional variant naming for character-specific basic Strikes.
Strike_B.fix: Kept as-is to avoid breaking the DB loader.

Strike_G.detail: See Strike_B note. Same pattern for the Silent (green) variant.

Strike_P.detail: See Strike_B note. Same pattern for the Watcher (purple) variant.

Strike_R.detail: See Strike_B note. Same pattern for the Ironclad (red) variant.
